Polls show Democrats gaining edge in upcoming elections

Recent polls and online betting odds indicate a shift in favor of Democrats ahead of upcoming elections. An NPR poll suggests Democrats hold an edge over Republicans, partly attributed to former President Trump. Similarly, online betting odds for Democrats winning the Senate have significantly increased in the past two weeks, coinciding with new polling data and a decline in President Trump's approval ratings. Fortune reports that polls now show Democrats in a position to potentially take the Senate in the midterms.
